opener_hint: Day 26 of following AI until I reach 10% body fat.

lines.text: I ate carefully all day, and then a popcorn bucket at the cinema took half my deficit.
Gym day, so a short bike warm-up, then weights.
A banana before the gym and a whey shake when I got home.
Lunch was four eggs with lor, protein kaşar, olives and vegetables.
For the snack I made chocolate protein pancakes with a quark chocolate topping.
The plan was half the topped batch. I ate about a fifth, and my wife ended up eating almost all of it when I came back.
Dinner was rice with yesterday's chicken stir fry and some bean sprouts.
In the evening my wife and I went to the cinema and shared a popcorn bucket.
I thought half a popcorn would be enough to enjoy it and still keep a deficit.
That's seven days in a row under maintenance, even with the popcorn.
Just over a kilo of fat gone so far, about a tenth of the way.
Tomorrow: a raclette night with wine and dessert.
